import socket, struct, time, imaplib, re, email as _em, subprocess

VNC = ('localhost', 5900)
LOGIN_BTN  = (779, 505)

def ra(s, n):
    d = b''
    while len(d) < n:
        c = s.recv(n - len(d))
        if not c: raise ConnectionError('closed')
        d += c
    return d

def vnc_open():
    s = socket.create_connection(VNC, 10)
    ra(s, 12); s.sendall(b'RFB 003.008\n')
    n = ra(s, 1)[0]; sec = list(ra(s, n))
    if 1 in sec:
        s.sendall(bytes([1]))
        try:
            res = ra(s, 4)
            if struct.unpack('>I', res)[0] != 0: s.close(); return None
        except: pass
    s.sendall(bytes([1]))
    w = struct.unpack('>H', ra(s, 2))[0]
    h = struct.unpack('>H', ra(s, 2))[0]
    ra(s, 16)
    nl = struct.unpack('>I', ra(s, 4))[0]
    if nl: ra(s, nl)
    print(f'VNC {w}x{h}')
    return s

def click(x, y):
    s = vnc_open()
    if not s: print(f'click fail {x},{y}'); return
    s.sendall(struct.pack('>BBHH', 5, 1, x, y)); time.sleep(0.15)
    s.sendall(struct.pack('>BBHH', 5, 0, x, y)); s.close()
    print(f'click ({x},{y})')

def vtype(text):
    s = vnc_open()
    if not s: return
    for c in text:
        s.sendall(struct.pack('>BBHI', 4, 1, 0, ord(c))); time.sleep(0.05)
        s.sendall(struct.pack('>BBHI', 4, 0, 0, ord(c))); time.sleep(0.05)
    s.close(); print(f'typed {text}')

def vkeys(dn, up):
    s = vnc_open()
    if not s: return
    for k in dn: s.sendall(struct.pack('>BBHI', 4, 1, 0, k)); time.sleep(0.05)
    for k in up: s.sendall(struct.pack('>BBHI', 4, 0, 0, k)); time.sleep(0.05)
    s.close()

def get_code_after(conn, cutoff_dt):
    conn.select('INBOX')
    _, msgs = conn.search(None, 'FROM "no-reply@mail.kabu.com" SINCE "13-Apr-2026"')
    uids = msgs[0].split()
    for uid in reversed(uids[-10:]):
        _, data = conn.fetch(uid, '(RFC822)')
        raw = data[0][1] if data and data[0] else b''
        msg = _em.message_from_bytes(raw)
        date_str = msg.get('Date', '')
        try:
            msg_dt = email.utils.parsedate_to_datetime(date_str)
            if msg_dt.tzinfo is None:
                import pytz; msg_dt = pytz.utc.localize(msg_dt)
        except Exception:
            continue
        if msg_dt <= cutoff_dt:
            continue  # old email
        body = ''
        if msg.is_multipart():
            for p in msg.walk():
                if p.get_content_type() == 'text/plain':
                    body = p.get_payload(decode=True).decode('utf-8', errors='replace'); break
        else:
            body = msg.get_payload(decode=True).decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
        m = re.search(r'\u8a8d\u8a3c\u30b3\u30fc\u30c9.*?(\d{6})', body, re.S)
        if m:
            return m.group(1), date_str
    return '', ''
